mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to potential monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances over the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, positively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances over the next 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase, it suggests a recovery in the labor market, which can positively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS increases, but S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances over the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it indicates strong consumer demand and a healthy labor market, positively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand and healthy labor market
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases, but S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances over the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals robust economic growth, which positively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases over two consecutive quarters and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances over the next 60 trading days.
